onboarding.essa_e_uma_previa_rapida: this is a quick preview — eight screens, half a minute each. kami's common thread: every action you record in any module credits xp to an attribute, levels it up and can unlock achievements. I'll use the same example on more than one screen so you can see how one module feeds the other.
onboarding.o_coracao_da_gamificacao_5: the heart of the gamification: 5 attributes that level up as you record actions, a chronological log of everything done, fixed-rule achievements and the priorities panel. notice the last line of the log down there — that learning milestone will show up again two screens from now.
onboarding.renda_recorrente_com_cadastro: recurring income with its own setup (several sources, fixed day/business day/day interval/depends on another source, or one-off) and real business-day calculation, cards, fixed bills, debts, installment purchases, subscriptions and one-off expenses — a monthly view of income vs. expenses, compared with the previous month, plus charts for cash flow, categories, evolution and card limits. every transaction here also becomes a line in the core log, with xp like any other module.
onboarding.trilhas_de_estudo_com_marcos: study tracks with milestones, automatically calculated progress, a visual roadmap with drag-and-drop to reorder and a GitHub-style heatmap. that "python fundamentals" milestone completed here is exactly what produced the +20 xp you saw in the core log, two screens back.
onboarding.metas_financeiras_tipo_aquela: financial goals (like that trip down there) or free-form ones, each with a deadline and contribution history. look at the second one: learning goals are linked to a track — the same programming one you saw — and move forward on their own as milestones are completed, with nothing to update by hand. that closes the loop: one milestone completed in learning became xp in the core and progress here, all from the same action.
onboarding.trilha_programacao_avanca_soz: track: programming · moves on its own
onboarding.todo_compromisso_financeiro_c: every financial commitment (fixed bills, debts, installments, subscriptions), goal with a deadline and completed milestone lands here automatically, each type with its own color — no need to enter anything twice. you can also create manual events, drag them to another day, filter by type within a specific day and see alerts for what's due soon.
onboarding.area_atual_e_area_meta: current field and target field, professional interests, a timeline of positions (company, role, period), education and salary history with a chart. every position, completed degree or recorded salary also turns into xp in the core — the same pattern you saw on the other screens. that was just the shell — when you open each screen for real, I'll show tips specific to each button and widget, right there.
kami_intro.a_partir_de_agora_sou: From now on I'm the one who'll help you organize your life — career, finances, learning, goals, all in one place.
kami_intro.funciono_como_um_jogo_toda: I work like a game: every action you record turns into xp for an attribute, levels up, unlocks achievements. Getting organized stops being a chore.
kami_intro.e_pode_ficar_tranquilo_a: And rest easy: everything runs here, on your machine. nothing leaves, no server, no account to create.
kami_intro.alias_falando_nisso_eu_nem: By the way — I don't even know your name yet...
kami_intro.por_ultimo_quer_gerar_um: Last thing — want to make an ascii avatar from a photo? it's quick, and you can skip it if you'd rather.
kami_intro.arraste_uma_imagem_ou_use: drag an image or use the field above. the original photo is never saved.
kami_intro.escolher_uma_imagem_para_o: choose an image for the avatar
captura.previa.entrada: goes to the inbox — decide later what it becomes
captura.rodape: <kbd>$</kbd> 25 lunch = expense · <kbd>#</kbd> idea = note · <kbd>!</kbd> tomorrow 9am dentist = event · <kbd>@</kbd> 6pm medicine = reminder · enter saves · esc closes
atualizacao.confirmar: kami will save a copy of the database, download version {versao}, install it and reopen.
backend_watchdog.tentando_de_novo: it stopped responding; trying again on its own.
backend_watchdog.nao_reiniciou: couldn't restart on its own. try restarting; if it keeps happening, open the log folder and attach kami-backend.log to a report.
layout_novidade.oferta: the default layout of {telas} got better: widgets in aligned rows. apply it? you can undo right after.

layout_novidade.aplicadas.one: {telas} now has the new default layout.
layout_novidade.aplicadas.other: {telas} now have the new default layout.

streak_notice.coberto.one: a day went blank and a shield saved your {dias} streak
streak_notice.coberto.other: {n} days went blank and shields saved your {dias} streak

native_notify.oculto.lembretes: you have a reminder — open kami to see it
native_notify.oculto.vencimentos: something is coming due — open kami to see it
native_notify.oculto.eventos: you have an event — open kami to see it
lock_screen.aviso_codigo: write it down or download it now — it won't be shown again. it's the only way to change the PIN if you forget it.
lock_screen.feche_e_apague: close kami and delete the pin.json file from the data folder:
lock_screen.pin_novo_tamanho: the new PIN has {min} to {max} digits (numbers only)
onboarding.desc_perfil: this is you: your name, {cor} as the accent color — you can change it whenever you like, even now if you change your mind — and the ascii avatar, made 100% locally from a photo that's never saved. profile and core accept the same configurable widgets: drag, resize, add, remove.
onboarding.desc_organizacao: quick-access hub: categorized links, the status of your GitHub repositories, real IMAP e-mail — subject, sender and a plain-text snippet of the body, no third-party HTML and no AI reading anything for now — and a web search with an inline summary (optional personal key; without it, it goes straight to DuckDuckGo).
onboarding.titulo_carreira: career — this is just a preview, {nome}
kami_intro.prontinho: All set, {nome}. Shall we take a tour of the system?
atualizacao.rpm_como: kami downloads the .rpm, asks for your system password to install it and reopens
atualizacao.rpm_senha: the system will ask for your password to install the package.
aparencia.moeda.desc: the symbol and format of amounts across the app. it only changes how they look — no amount is converted.
aparencia.pais.desc: the holidays that count for business days — a paycheck on the "5th business day", for example. a country without a known calendar only skips saturday and sunday.
erro.actions.esta_acao_foi_registrada_au: this action was recorded automatically by a module — undo it there (e.g.: reopen the milestone, delete the transaction)
erro.finance_utils.essa_operacao_so_acei: this operation only accepts payment by {permitidas_str}, not by {forma_pagamento}
erro.finance_utils.essa_conta_nao_possui: this account has no balance to receive income
erro.finance_utils.essa_conta_tem_saldo_: this account has both balance and credit — set 'forma_pagamento' ('saldo' or 'credito')
erro.finance_utils.saldo_insuficiente_di: insufficient balance: {valor_saldo_atual} available, trying to spend {valor_amount}
erro.finance_utils.essa_conta_nao_possui: this account has neither balance nor credit set up
erro.finance_utils.limite_insuficiente_d: insufficient limit: {valor_disponivel} available, trying to spend {valor_amount}
erro.aprendizado.lista_precisa_conter_ex: the list must contain exactly the current tracks, none missing and none extra
the list must contain exactly the track's current milestones, none missing and none extra
erro.carreira.valor_deve_ser_maior_zero: the amount must be greater than zero
erro.carteira.ja_existe_conta_com_esse: there's already an account with that name at this bank
erro.carteira.conta_vinculada_assinatura: the account linked to the subscription no longer exists
erro.carteira.conta_vinculada_precisa_te: the linked account needs credit set up
erro.dashboard.widget_type_invalido_widg: invalid widget_type: '{widget_type}'; not in the fixed catalog
erro.dashboard.widget_s_obrigatorio_s_au: required widget(s) missing from the layout: {valores}
erro.entrada.item_nao_encontrado_na_caix: item not found in the inbox
erro.contas.conta_vinculada_conta_fixa_n: the account linked to the fixed bill no longer exists
erro.lancamentos.este_lancamento_veio_or: this transaction came from {origem} — undo it there (e.g.: unmark the payment)
erro.lancamentos.conta_origem_transferen: the source account of a transfer needs a balance
erro.lancamentos.saldo_insuficiente_essa: insufficient balance for this transfer: {valor_saldo_atual} available, trying to transfer {valor_amount}
erro.lancamentos.informe_exatamente_dest: set exactly one destination: 'conta_destino_id' (internal) or 'destino_externo' (free text)
erro.lancamentos.conta_destino_precisa_t: the destination account needs a balance
erro.renda.nao_possivel_remover_existe_m: can't remove it: other source(s) depend on this one (chaining).
erro.renda.conta_vinculada_fonte_renda_n: the account linked to the income source no longer exists
erro.renda.fonte_nao_pode_depender_si: a source can't depend on itself
erro.renda.esse_encadeamento_formaria_ci: this chaining would create a cycle
erro.comum.escolha_pelo_menos_dia_semana: choose at least one day of the week
erro.habitos.nao_marcar_dia_ainda_nao: you can't check off a day that hasn't come yet
erro.habitos.so_mexer_ate_dias_para: you can only change up to {dias_para_tras} days back
erro.habitos.habito_pausado_ou_arquivado: habit paused or archived — resume it to check off
erro.habitos.esse_dia_nao_esta_na: this day isn't in the habit's schedule
erro.lembretes.item_vinculado_nao_existe: the linked item no longer exists
erro.metas.alvo_precisa_ser_maior_zero: the target must be greater than zero
erro.metas.meta_tipo_type_progride_sozin: a '{type}' goal progresses on its own along with the {origem_label} — it doesn't accept manual contributions
erro.metas.meta_ja_concluida_nao_aceita: goal already completed — it doesn't accept new contributions
erro.metas.valor_contribuicao_precisa_se: the contribution amount must be greater than zero
erro.metas.meta_tipo_aprendizado_precisa: a learning goal needs a linked track
erro.metas.meta_tipo_academica_precisa_f: an academic goal needs a linked degree
erro.metas.informe_conta_id_ou_cadastre: set 'conta_id' (or add a default account to the goal) to contribute from an account
erro.notas.nota_trancada_abra_com_pin: locked note — open it with the PIN to edit
erro.notas.ative_pin_configuracoes_segur: turn on the PIN in settings › security to lock notes
erro.busca.nenhuma_chave_busca_configura: no search key set up — add a tavily key in organization
erro.busca.sem_conexao_com_api_tavily: no connection to the tavily api to validate the key
erro.busca.chave_busca_corrompida_reconf: search key corrupted — set up the key again
erro.busca.erro_http_code_na_api: http error {code} from the search api
erro.busca.sem_conexao_com_api_busca: no connection to the search api right now
erro.busca.chave_busca_invalida_reconfig: invalid search key — set up the key again
erro.busca.limite_mensal_buscas_gratuita: monthly limit of free searches reached
erro.emails.mail_nao_encontrado_no_cache: e-mail not found in the cache
erro.emails.nao_foi_possivel_ler_senha: couldn't read the saved password; edit the account and enter the app password again
erro.emails.falha_ao_autenticar_no_imap: imap authentication failed; check host/port/user/app password
erro.emails.nao_foi_possivel_conectar_ao: couldn't connect to the imap server
erro.emails.banco_dados_ocupado_por_outr: database busy with another sync; try again in a few seconds
erro.github.sem_conexao_com_api_github: no connection to the github api to validate the token
erro.sistema.confirmacao_invalida_envie_: invalid confirmation; send confirmation='{import_confirmation_word}' to proceed
erro.sistema.arquivo_nao_parece_ser_back: the file doesn't look like a valid Kami backup (user_profile missing)
erro.sistema.confirmacao_invalida_envie_: invalid confirmation; send confirmation='{reset_confirmation_word}' to proceed
erro.sistema.este_backup_protegido_infor: this backup is protected — enter the password
erro.sistema.arquivo_nao_parece_ser_back: the file doesn't look like a valid Kami backup
erro.sistema.falha_ao_importar_backup_ar: importing the backup failed — corrupted, incompatible or inconsistent file; nothing was changed ({exc})
erro.carteira.ajuste_sem_adiantamento: invalid adjustment: there's no advance payment to undo
erro.carteira.ajuste_ja_quitada: invalid adjustment: the purchase is already paid off
erro.pin.esperando: too many wrong attempts — wait {segundos} s
erro.pin.tamanho_numeros: the PIN has 4 to 8 digits (numbers only)
erro.backup.senha_curta: the password needs at least {n} characters
erro.backup.formato_desconhecido: unknown protected backup format — exported by a newer version of Kami?
erro.backup.senha_errada: wrong password — or the file was changed after it was exported
erro.copias.caminho_completo: use the full path of the folder (e.g.: /media/usb/kami or D:\kami)
erro.copias.pasta_inexistente: this folder doesn't exist (USB drive or disk connected?)
erro.copias.sem_escrita: Kami can't write to this folder
erro.validacao.less_than_equal: must be less than or equal to {le}
erro.validacao.greater_than_equal: must be greater than or equal to {ge}
assistente.descricao: optional and off by default. it talks through the AI provider you choose — no key ships with Kami, and Kami works fully without it.
assistente.em_uso_local: local — what you write doesn't leave this computer (or your network)
assistente.em_uso_nuvem: cloud — what you write goes to {host}
assistente.provedores_desc: you can save more than one (e.g. a free cloud one and a local one) and pick which to use. the API key is stored encrypted, protected by the system keyring.
assistente.selo_deve_funcionar: should work (not yet tested by Kami)
assistente.resultado_ok: worked in {seg} s: connected and the model uses tools
assistente.resultado_sem_ferramentas: connected in {seg} s, but this model didn't use the test tool — it can chat, but it won't be able to look up your data. consider picking another model
assistente.remover_confirma: remove {nome}? its saved key is deleted.
assistente.gratuito_limitado: has a free tier, with limits
assistente.aviso_troca_endereco: the address changed: saving deletes the stored key (it only goes to the address it was pasted for). paste the key again if it's valid for the new address.
assistente.modelo_placeholder: type it or search the list

assistente.modelos_encontrados.zero: the provider listed no models — type the model name
assistente.modelos_encontrados.one: {n} model found — pick it from the list
assistente.modelos_encontrados.other: {n} models found — pick one from the list

assistente.escolha_um_modelo: choose a model (search the list or type the name)
assistente.limites_desc: they protect your money and your free quota: when the daily limit is reached, the assistant stops and tells you why. they apply to cloud providers; local ones cost nothing.
assistente.local_sem_teto: the provider in use is local: usage is counted, but not limited
erro.assistente.chave_ilegivel: this provider's saved key couldn't be read — paste the key again
erro.assistente.fora_do_limite: value out of range: use between {min} and {max}
erro.assistente.provedor.chave_invalida: the provider rejected the key — check that you pasted the whole key and that it's still active
erro.assistente.provedor.sem_credito: your account with the provider is out of credit or quota
erro.assistente.provedor.limite: the provider asked to wait: too many calls in a short time
erro.assistente.provedor.modelo_indispon: that model isn't available from this provider — pick another one from the list
erro.assistente.provedor.sem_ferramentas: that model doesn't support tools — pick another one from the list
erro.assistente.provedor.url_errada: the address didn't respond like an AI API — check the URL
erro.assistente.provedor.redirecionado: the address redirected elsewhere ({local}) — for safety Kami doesn't follow it; check the URL
erro.assistente.provedor.sem_conexao: couldn't connect to the provider — check your internet or, if it's local, whether the program is running
erro.assistente.provedor.tempo_esgotado: the provider took too long to respond
erro.assistente.provedor.servidor: the provider is having trouble right now — try again in a bit
erro.assistente.provedor.resposta_invali: the provider sent something Kami couldn't understand
erro.assistente.teto.chamadas: the assistant reached today's limit of {teto} calls — you can change it in settings › assistant
erro.assistente.teto.tokens: the assistant reached today's limit of {teto} tokens — you can change it in settings › assistant
erro.assistente.url.credenciais: the address can't contain a username or password
erro.assistente.url.esquema: the address must start with https://
erro.assistente.url.http_fora_da_rede: http:// only works for this computer or the local network — use https://
assistente.chat.placeholder: ask something… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assistente.chat.falta_provedor: the assistant isn't set up yet: choose an AI provider.
assistente.chat.falta_modelo: the provider's model still needs to be chosen.
assistente.chat.falta_chave: the provider's API key still needs to be pasted.
assistente.chat.opcional: it's optional: Kami works fully without it.
assistente.chat.o_que_faz: I'm Kami's assistant: I help with finances, career, learning, goals, habits, organization and the app itself. I'm not a virtual friend — I decline anything outside that.
assistente.chat.historico_desc: conversations stay only on this computer and are deleted after {dias} days without use.
assistente.chat.historico_nao_guarda: "keep conversations" is off: new conversations disappear when you close Kami.
assistente.chat.apagar_tudo_confirma: delete all conversations and the record of what was sent? this can't be undone.
assistente.chat.envios_desc: each call to the provider: where it went, with which model and what was new in it (your message, Kami's instructions and, later, the data the assistant looked up). passwords, keys and e-mails never leave.
assistente.chat.enviado_continuar: request to continue the cut-off answer without repeating what was already written
assistente.chat.largura_dica: drag to change the width · double-click resets it
assistente.chat.apagar_registro_confirma: delete the record of what was sent? conversations stay.
assistente.conversas_desc: the assistant never uses an old conversation in a new one: each conversation starts from scratch. keeping them is only so you can reread them.
assistente.guardar_conversas_dica: when off, a conversation disappears when you close Kami. those already saved stay until you delete them.
erro.assistente.nada_pra_continuar: there's no cut-off answer to continue
erro.assistente.desligado: the assistant is turned off — turn it on in settings › assistant

assistente.desligar_guardar_pergunta.one: you have {n} saved conversation. delete it too (along with the record of what was sent)?
assistente.desligar_guardar_pergunta.other: you have {n} saved conversations. delete them too (along with the record of what was sent)?

assistente.cuidado.acolhimento: I'm sorry you're going through this. You don't have to deal with it without support: talking to someone right now can help — and if you're in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
assistente.cuidado.reserva: find a free support line in your country at:
assistente.cuidado.volta: whenever you want, I'm still here to help with Kami.
assistente.pode_ler_desc: it only reads when a question needs it, and only a slice: summaries and a few items. e-mails, cards, documents, keys and phones go out as [removido]. nothing is changed.
assistente.pode_ler_nota: notes start turned off. locked notes are never read, even with notes on. e-mails and saved passwords never.
assistente.sugestao.contas_semana: what's due in the next 7 days?
assistente.sugestao.onde_gastei_mais: where did I spend the most this month?
assistente.sugestao.metas_perto: which goal is closest to done?
assistente.sugestao.metas_prazo: any goal with a deadline coming up?
assistente.sugestao.trilhas_paradas: do I have any stalled track?
assistente.sugestao.proximo_marco: what milestone should I do next?
assistente.sugestao.habitos_hoje: which habits are left for today?
assistente.sugestao.habitos_semana: how did my habits go this week?
assistente.sugestao.agenda_semana: what's on my calendar this week?
assistente.sugestao.como_carreira: how does the career screen work?
assistente.sugestao.como_usar: what can I do in Kami?
